description: Manage Superchat contacts, conversations, text messages, channels, labels and webhook subscriptions.

superchat_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when new contact is observed in Superchat. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

superchat_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs when new conversation is observed in Superchat. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

superchat_new_message_trigger.description: Runs when new message is observed in Superchat. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

parameters.description: The conversation to watch.
parameters.name: id

superchat_new_or_updated_contact_trigger.description: Runs when new or updated contact is observed in Superchat. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

superchat_new_or_updated_conversation_tr.description: Runs when new or updated conversation is observed in Superchat. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
